channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 3 Dead After News Helicopter Crashes in LA Near Earlier Bus Collision Site
item.description: The NTSB and FAA are investigating the crash in Chatsworth, California.

item.title: Gaza building damaged by strike collapses, killing at least 20
item.description: Gaza health officials report that a building struck months ago by Israel has collapsed, killing members of six displaced families who had sought shelter there.

item.title: Trust seal made sites appear legitimate; weight-loss drug was not
item.description: Federal law prohibits commercial sale of retatrutide, yet companies promoted the drug on social media, partly by obtaining certification.

item.title: All Ed Sheeran opening acts exit tour after Macklemore removed
item.description: Ed Sheeran responds after Macklemore says he was removed from the tour for making political statements on stage.
